newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen up on market package.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen up on market package.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to makes gains on Wednesday after the government announced a package to boost the capital market on Tuesday, dealers said.
"The package is positive, which will boost the stocks today," dealer Rony Byramjee said.
The package gave an exemption on capital gains tax for three more years, exempted bonus shares from tax and removed a 0.5 percent turnover tax on the sale or purchase of shares.
On Monday, the index fell 1.04 points, or 0.07 percent, to end at 1,541.31. Losers led gainers 159 to 72 in a turnover of 50.55 million shares.
